name: Heavy-Duty Industrial Hydraulic Cylinder
shortDescription: Precision-honed double-acting hydraulic cylinder engineered for high-pressure stamping, pressing, and heavy industrial actuation.
fullDescription: The VT-HC series hydraulic cylinders are engineered for demanding continuous-duty applications where thermal surge pressures and shock loads occur. Constructed from high-tensile cold-drawn ST52 steel tubing with internal micro-honing down to Ra 0.2 µm, each unit features an induction-hardened, hard-chrome-plated piston rod and multi-lip polyurethane step-seal packaging.
features: Induction-hardened chrome rod resists side-impact deflection
Dual polyurethane gland step-seals prevent external weeping
Adjustable end-position progressive cushioning for impact absorption
Tested 100% via hydrostatic pressure schedule prior to shipment

name: Precision Cam Rotary Indexing Table
shortDescription: High-accuracy globoidal cam indexing table designed for automated multi-station assembly, drilling, and robotic lines.
fullDescription: The VT-RT series provides high mechanical repeatability and smooth acceleration curves without backlash. Engineered with a hardened and ground globoidal cam engaging preloaded needle-bearing cam followers, it converts uniform input shaft rotation into intermittent index motion for multi-station assembly carousels.

specifications.label: Drive Compatibility
specifications.value: SEW / Bonfiglioli Servo or Brake Motor

features: Zero-backlash globoidal cam mechanism for prolonged precision life
Cast iron housing dampens high-frequency indexing vibrations
Direct central hollow-shaft option for pneumatic and sensor harness routing
Splash-lubricated internal sump requires minimal maintenance

name: High-Torque Planetary Reduction Gearbox
shortDescription: Robust multi-stage planetary gearbox engineered for extreme-duty industrial material handling, mining, and winches.
fullDescription: Engineered for high power density within compact envelope constraints, the VT-PGB series planetary gearboxes feature case-hardened and ground sun and planet gears (18CrNiMo7-6) mounted inside ductile iron housing structures. The multi-planet carrier architecture distributes torque equally across sun gears, achieving up to 96% efficiency per stage.
features: Crowned gear tooth geometry for optimal flank contact under deflection
Taper roller bearings on output shaft resist extreme axial & radial loads
High thermal capacity casing with optional cooling coil integration
100% end-of-line spin tested with vibration FFT analysis

name: Custom CNC-Milled Hydraulic Manifold Block
shortDescription: Monoblock hydraulic distribution manifold with integrated cavity routing for high-pressure industrial systems.
fullDescription: Our custom hydraulic manifold blocks replace complex, leak-prone pipe networks with a compact, unified distribution module. Milled from certified ductile iron or aerospace aluminium blocks, each manifold incorporates cross-drilled flow galleries designed to minimize laminar turbulence and fluid velocity pressure drops.
applications: CNC Machine Tool Hydraulic Power Units (HPU)
features: Zero cross-channel breakout guaranteed by 3D CAD clearance verification
Ultrasonically deburred and flushed in dedicated cleanroom tank
Plugs with Viton O-rings pre-torqued and pressure tested
Laser-etched port markings (P, T, A, B, G) for straightforward field hookup

name: 5-Axis CNC Milled Aerodynamic Impeller
shortDescription: High-speed precision impeller with 3D twisted aerodynamic blades for compressors, turbines, and centrifugal equipment.
fullDescription: Precision machined directly from solid billet forging using continuous 5-axis CNC machining centers, the VT-IMP series eliminates structural weaknesses found in cast impellers. Blade profiles undergo computational aerodynamic verification for optimal pressure ratios, and finished units are dynamically balanced to ISO 1940 Grade G1.0.

specifications.label: Bore Tolerance
specifications.value: ISO H6 Precision Bore with Keyway

features: Machined from solid forged billet for superior fatigue and burst strength
Complex 3D ruled and free-form blade profiles with G2 curvature continuity
Non-destructive testing (NDT) dye-penetrant inspection verified
Supplied with certified dynamic balancing report certificate

name: Heavy-Duty Split Pillow Block Bearing Housing
shortDescription: Standardized two-piece modular bearing housing designed for heavy rotating industrial shafts under severe vibration.
fullDescription: The VT-PBH series split bearing housings are engineered to safeguard spherical roller bearings in heavy industrial environments. Built with high-strength ductile iron bases, reinforced cap ribs, and integrated labyrinth seals, they prevent lubricant escape and particulate contamination in dusty or wet operational environments.
features: Two-piece split construction enables fast bearing inspection and replacement
Ductile iron cap ribs prevent bore distortion under extreme radial loading
Precision-machined bearing seat bore (ISO H7) prevents outer-ring creep
Grease relief drain port avoids over-greasing hydraulic pressure build-up
